messages:
sam.m: Hey team — customer reported invoice for org `redwood-acme` is ~18k tokens higher than the dashboard for March 9-10. Project tile shows 42k tokens, invoice line item 60k. Can someone triage?

jess.s: Thanks Sam. Do we have the invoice id + project id? Also did they have any cross-org projects or shared pools?

sam.m: Invoice ID inv_20260310_9021, project proj-acme-web (proj_778). They said the org has a shared burst pool enabled. No obvious multi-project usage in their report.

raj.e: pinging billing infra. First guesses: (1) delayed ledger rollup created duplicate aggregation, (2) rolling-window attribution double-counted at org vs project, (3) invoice used UTC cut vs dashboard local tz. I'll start with ledger logs.

billing-bot: invoice generated: inv_20260310_9021 | org=org_334 | tokens=60321 | period=2026-03-09..2026-03-10 | source=batch-ledger-v2

matt-ops: Sam/Jess — can you grab a couple of request_ids (from customer) that they think belong to the discrepancy? A short sample helps traceroute through KV cache and metering path.

sam.m: Got two request ids from customer: req_aa71 and req_bb22. They correspond to nested chat calls in our logs. Customer says those are in dashboard and match token counts there.

raj.e: Running quick lookup: 
```
SELECT * FROM ledger_events WHERE request_id IN ('req_aa71','req_bb22');
```
Result shows two ledger entries with tokens=0 and later a batch summary with tokens assigned. There's also a second batch summary 2m later that re-aggregated same request_ids. Looks like batch dedupe missed a window boundary.

lina-p: That aligns with a recent change — batch-rollup job now picks up events based on event_time floor(window_size) and we had a TTL bug that caused reprocessing of events in overlapping windows. We pushed a fix yesterday but it only rolled out to non-prod.

jess.s: Oof. Could that double-count produce ~18k tokens?

lina-p: Possibly. If a few long-chat sessions (50-100k tokens each) were re-summarized, totals could jump. Need to check which sessions were large.

raj.e: I'm pulling session lengths for proj_778 for the window: `SELECT session_id, SUM(tokens) FROM sessions WHERE project_id='proj_778' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-09' AND '2026-03-10' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY SUM(tokens) DESC LIMIT 50;`

billing-bot: ledger_reconciliation job started for period 2026-03-09..2026-03-10 | job_id=lr_5542

matt-ops: Two actions: (A) run idempotency/dedupe to drop overlapping batch duplicates and (B) re-run invoice preview for org_334 after clean. Sam, tell customer we suspect duplicate aggregation and that we're investigating; ask for patience.

sam.m: OK will message them: "We're investigating — suspected duplicate aggregation during rollup. We'll update with ETA shortly." :thumbsup:

jess.s: If we confirm this, we need to: 1) patch prod batch-rollup to include event watermark check, 2) reconcile invoices (credit if overbilled), 3) add alert for spike in invoice vs dashboard > X% during rollup windows.

raj.e: ledger_reconciliation job finished. Preliminary diff: invoice_tokens - dashboard_tokens = +17984 for org_334. Drilldown shows ~18 sessions reprocessed twice. I can run a dedupe patch now and emit corrected summary.

lina-p: I'll promote the non-prod fix to prod with a quick migration plan (feature flag + smoke checks). Need 20m maintenance window but patch is small.

matt-ops: Coordinate with finance for issuing a credit if post-dedupe invoice drops. Finance needs corrected invoice number and a note.

sam.m: On it. I'll update customer and loop finance once we have corrected totals.

jess.s: Great. Please drop the corrected ledger summary and final numbers in this thread when ready.
